# Priscilla Grant

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c22 P4](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0004)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Pris  <sub>[v1 c32 P14](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0014)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla is described as a pale, spiritual-looking maiden with hair that looks as if she knows a thing or two about dreams. She has brown eyes and a crimson waist, presenting a vivid, red-rosy appearance.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P4](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0004), [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012)_

## Personality

Priscilla is full to the brim of mischief, pranks, and fun, while also possessing a thoughtful, imaginative, and ambitious nature. Contrary to her pale, spiritual appearance, she enjoys humor and engages in creative pursuits like story-writing, though she dislikes putting lovemaking into her tales because it makes her feel silly.

_Sources: [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c34 P4](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0004)_

## Traits

- Thoughtful and imaginative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- Ambitious  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- Full of mischief, pranks, and fun  <sub>[v1 c34 P4](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0004)</sub>

## Abilities

- Story writing  <sub>[v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021)</sub>
- Academic aptitude  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>

## Goals

- To study and become a teacher  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Priscilla Grant entered Queen's Academy in Charlottetown to pursue a Second Class teacher's license. There she formed a close friendship with Anne Shirley, Stella Maynard, and Philippa Gordon, becoming part of their ambitious circle of students. During her time at Queen's, she joined a girls' story club where members wrote weekly stories under pseudonyms, though she insisted on keeping romance out of her own sensible tales. Upon finishing her course, she secured a school to teach for the following year.

_Sources: [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c34 P4](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0004), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c36 P23](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0023)_
